title: Legacy fast routes share the same URL name
reasoning: Both legacy routes are registered with name="fast_on_date" even though they point to different views and paths. Django URL reversing by name cannot unambiguously target both endpoints, so code/tests/templates using reverse("fast_on_date") may resolve to only one of them and silently generate the wrong /api/ path for the other legacy contract.
recommendation: Give the two legacy endpoints distinct route names, preserving the currently used name only for the route that existing callers depend on and assigning a new explicit name to the other.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The included fast tests exercise request paths and view query behavior, but they do not assert URL reversing for these legacy route names.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a URLConf test that reverses both legacy endpoint names and asserts they produce /api/user/fasts/ and /api/fast/ respectively.
minimumFixScope: Rename one of the duplicate legacy URL names in hub/urls.py and update any internal reverse() callers if present.
